title: Heartbeat v1
description: Mac liveness ping — POST /v1/heartbeat. Extracted from contracts/openapi/boi-api.v1.yaml, which now $refs this file rather than carrying its own copy, so there is exactly one frozen definition.

digest_as_of.description: AMENDMENT-003: required and nullable, never optional. `null` is the claim that this device has never produced a digest; an absent key is a producer that forgot, and a fleet query cannot tell the second one from a bug in the Mac.

messages_access_state.description: Whether the Mac can currently resolve its security-scoped bookmark to the user's Messages folder. Optional and additive: a heartbeat that omits it validates exactly as before. `never_configured` — access has not been granted yet. `ok` — the bookmark resolves. `lost` — it stopped resolving, most likely because an app update re-signed the binary and invalidated the bookmark.
